result.title: Universal Approximation by Equivariant Message-Passing Graph Neural Networks with a Bilinear Readout
result.summary: We prove universal approximation for the bilinear-readout equivariant message-passing network (BREMP), a reference architecture for equivariant graph neural network interatomic potentials. Its layers combine equivariant convolutions with affine maps, and its readout forms invariants from products of the equivariant features. We construct a one-layer feature that determines the local environment up to permutations of atoms of the same type. The construction uses spherical harmonic filters of degree no larger than the largest number of neighbors at a common distance from the center. Iterating the construction recovers the environment reachable in as many hops as there are layers, using the same bound on filter degrees at the layer cutoff. The readout approximates every continuous invariant function of the features uniformly on compact sets. Together these give universal approximation of atomic energies at a prescribed physical range using a shorter layer cutoff. We assume that, throughout the admissible class, message passing reaches all neighbors in each physical environment within a common number of layers. Finally, DPA4, an interatomic potential architecture in production use, inherits this result by approximating the BREMP layers constructed in the proof and realizing the bilinear readout.

AI.brief_summary: 为等变消息传递图神经网络原子间势（BREMP）证明通用逼近：构造单层特征在同类原子置换意义下决定局部环境，并按跳数逐层扩展，双线性读出由等变特征乘积形成不变量并均匀逼近连续不变量函数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「特征是否足以唯一决定局部环境」的可辨识性论证与多线性读出，可能为讨论 VLM 内部状态能否保留几何与任务必要信息、以及如何诊断信息坍缩提供理论类比线索，可供核查。
